notes.title: We have now moved to Full Release
notes.notes:
We are so excited to finally bring you the full release version of Four Kings One War. Please enjoy this free to play game and  if you do please help us to continue to develop more and more features by purchasing our supporter skins.  We have so much more to go with this amazing game however if you are looking for deep deep strategy then you don't get any deeper (yet pure) than this.
Currently we are looking for strategists who really have the skills to show case what you can do with the strategy afforded in this game.  If you feel you are equipped then please join us on Discord and reach out to the Wizard who is taking on any challenges in search for the prodigy strategists out there.   Take on the Wizard, Beat the Wizard and get status promotion where you can join the other top strategists at the Four Kings One War round table.
